actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed over 10 units in the last round; punish with maximum severity affordable (82) and broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning: We need to act now. Observation round5: contributions: Resident2 contributed 2.1 (<10), Resident5 96 (>10). So a resident contributed over 10: Resident5. We must punish that resident with max severity affordable. Wallet=24.72, punishment_cost=0.3, max severity = floor(wallet / cost) = floor(24.72/0.3)= floor(82.4)=82. So punish Resident5 severity 82. Cost 82*0.3=24.6, leaves wallet ~0.12. Also can broadcast warning. That's allowed one physical punish and one broadcast. Do that.
